Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 82. Category: form. Royal Forms.

Power-Up
The user’s body turns golden except for the area
around the mouth, center of the chest, hands, feet, and
knees.
Increase your Power by 3
You deal an additional 1d8 to all damage
Increase your Movement Speed by 30 ft.
You gain an additional +2 to your AC
At the end of your turn, you lose 3 Stamina
